chapter_seo_title: Dao Yi Xian Ch. 190 – A Friendly Old Man and a Bloody Ambush on the Road
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang investigates a past threat, consults a map, and meets a harmless scholar. But a bandit ambush on the mountain road quickly reminds him that the Dao-Twisted World has no patience for peaceful travelers.
og_title: A Friendly Chat, Then a Bloodbath: Ch. 190 of Dao Yi Xian
og_description: Li Huowang plays the polite traveler, but a siege on the rocky road proves his sword is still the only language these mountains understand.
twitter_title: The Polite Daoist Who Lops Off Ears: Ch. 190 Recap
twitter_description: Bandits ignore the spring canon, Li Huowang ignores their threats, and an old scholar learns a very hard lesson about judging a book by its red robe.
